name: siyuan-sisyphus
description: Read, search, and safely edit your local SiYuan notes, databases, and flashcards with permission-checked writes
shortDescription: Read and safely edit SiYuan notes

setup.notice: Runs on your own machine: it needs the local SiYuan app with the Sisyphus plugin, so it works in Devin Desktop or the CLI, not in cloud sessions.
steps: Install the Sisyphus plugin from the SiYuan bazaar and keep SiYuan running
Copy the API token from SiYuan Settings → About and save it as SIYUAN_TOKEN
